system.description:
Effect: Creates an immediate-radius explosion of toxic gas up to a short distance away. Make separate Speed attacks against each creature in the area. Success means they take 4 damage; failure means they still take 2 damage. About half of these cyphers inflict Might damage and half inflict Speed damage.

Genre Items: venom emerald (fantasy); toxin grenade (sci-fi)
